description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application, initializing the React app by rendering the main <App /> component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It also imports necessary dependencies such as React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components to the DOM node associated with the root.
